recipe_name: Apple, Oat & Cinnamon Morning Bowl
legacy_recipe_name: The Healthy Apples Apple, Oat & Cinnamon Morning Bowl
ingredients: 600ml semi-skimmed milk or unsweetened oat milk
method: Put the oats, milk, water, grated apple and cinnamon in a saucepan.
Bring to a gentle simmer and cook for 6–8 minutes, stirring often, until creamy.
Stir in half the diced apple for the final minute.
Spoon into bowls and top with remaining apple, seeds and walnuts.
Finish with a little honey only if wanted.
why_this_works_for_tha: Wholegrain oats, apple, seeds and nuts create a filling whole-food breakfast with sweetness from fruit rather than added sugar.

recipe_name: Chickpea, Lemon & Spinach Soup
legacy_recipe_name: The Healthy Apples Chickpea, Lemon & Spinach Soup
ingredients: Black pepper and a little salt
method: Heat the olive oil in a large pan and cook onion, carrots and celery for 8 minutes.
Add garlic, cumin and coriander and cook for 1 minute.
Stir in tomato purée, chickpeas and stock.
Simmer for 12–15 minutes until the vegetables are tender.
Blitz a third of the soup if a thicker texture is wanted.
Stir in spinach and lemon juice, season lightly and serve with wholegrain bread.
why_this_works_for_tha: Chickpeas, vegetables and spinach make a filling plant-forward lunch with flavour from lemon, cumin and coriander rather than heavy salt.

recipe_name: Basil Tomato Wholewheat Pasta
legacy_recipe_name: The Healthy Apples Basil Tomato Wholewheat Pasta
ingredients: Black pepper and a little salt
30g Parmesan or vegetarian hard cheese, optional
method: Cook onion gently in olive oil for 8 minutes.
Add garlic and oregano and cook for 1 minute.
Stir in tomato purée, chopped tomatoes and balsamic vinegar.
Simmer for 15–18 minutes until thickened.
Cook pasta until just tender, reserving a little pasta water.
Toss pasta through the sauce and finish with basil.
why_this_works_for_tha: A familiar pasta meal made from real tomatoes, onion, garlic and herbs, with wholewheat pasta for extra fibre and fullness.

recipe_name: Golden Potato, Chickpea & Spinach Curry
legacy_recipe_name: The Healthy Apples Golden Potato, Chickpea & Spinach Curry
ingredients: Brown basmati rice or wholemeal flatbreads, to serve
method: Cook onion in oil for 8 minutes until soft.
Add garlic and ginger for 1 minute, then stir in spices.
Add potatoes, chopped tomatoes and stock.
Cover and simmer for 15 minutes.
Add chickpeas and cook for 8–10 minutes more until potatoes are tender.
Stir through spinach and serve with brown rice or wholemeal flatbreads.
why_this_works_for_tha: A mild curry made from aromatics and spices, with chickpeas, potatoes and spinach for a filling plant-forward dinner.

recipe_name: Gentle Taco Rice Bowls
legacy_recipe_name: The Healthy Apples Gentle Taco Rice Bowls
ingredients: Shredded lettuce, tomato, avocado, lime and natural yoghurt, to serve
method: Cook brown rice until tender.
Cook onion and pepper in olive oil for 6–7 minutes.
Add garlic and beef mince and brown well.
Stir in cumin, smoked paprika, oregano and tomato purée.
Add tomatoes, black beans and sweetcorn and simmer for 10 minutes.
Serve over rice with lettuce, tomato, avocado, lime and yoghurt.
why_this_works_for_tha: A small amount of quality beef is stretched with beans, vegetables and brown rice, keeping the meal plant-forward and filling.

recipe_name: Roast Vegetable & Butter Bean Traybake
legacy_recipe_name: The Healthy Apples Roast Vegetable & Butter Bean Traybake
ingredients: Wholegrain bread or brown rice, to serve
method: Heat oven to 200°C fan.
Toss courgettes, peppers, onion and tomatoes with garlic, olive oil and herbs.
Roast for 20 minutes.
Whisk tomato purée, balsamic vinegar and a little water into a dressing.
Add butter beans and dressing to tray and roast for 15–18 minutes more.
Scatter with herbs and serve with wholegrain bread or brown rice.
why_this_works_for_tha: Vegetables lead the tray, butter beans make it filling, and the sauce is built from tomato purée, vinegar, herbs and roasting juices.

recipe_name: Chicken, Leek & Wholewheat Orzo One-Pot
legacy_recipe_name: The Healthy Apples Chicken, Leek & Wholewheat Orzo One-Pot
ingredients: 4 higher-welfare skinless boneless chicken thighs, cut into pieces
method: Brown chicken pieces in olive oil, then lift out.
Cook leeks and carrots for 6–7 minutes.
Add garlic and thyme for 1 minute.
Return chicken to pan, add orzo and stock and simmer for 12–14 minutes, stirring often.
Stir in peas and spinach for 2–3 minutes.
Finish with lemon zest and juice.
why_this_works_for_tha: A modest amount of quality chicken supports a pot led by leeks, carrots, peas, spinach and wholewheat orzo.

recipe_name: Lentil & Root Vegetable Cottage Pie
legacy_recipe_name: The Healthy Apples Lentil & Root Vegetable Cottage Pie
ingredients: 30g butter and 3 tbsp milk for mash
method: Cook onion, carrot, celery and parsnip in olive oil for 10 minutes.
Add garlic and tomato purée.
Add lentils, chopped tomatoes, stock and thyme and simmer until thick and tender.
Stir in peas.
Boil potatoes and swede, then mash with butter and milk.
Spoon lentil base into a dish, top with mash and bake at 200°C for 25–30 minutes.
why_this_works_for_tha: Lentils and root vegetables make a filling family bake with savoury depth from slow-cooked vegetables rather than packet gravy.

recipe_name: Salmon, Broccoli & Brown Rice Traybake
legacy_recipe_name: The Healthy Apples Salmon, Broccoli & Brown Rice Traybake
ingredients: 1 large head broccoli, cut into florets
method: Cook brown rice until tender.
Heat oven to 200°C fan.
Toss broccoli and tomatoes with olive oil, garlic, oregano and lemon zest.
Roast for 12 minutes.
Nestle salmon into tray and roast for 12–14 minutes more.
Serve over brown rice with lemon juice and herbs.
why_this_works_for_tha: Quality salmon sits alongside generous broccoli, tomatoes and brown rice, creating a simple whole-food fish dinner.

recipe_name: Roasted Carrot, Chickpea & Herb Grain Salad
legacy_recipe_name: The Healthy Apples Roasted Carrot, Chickpea & Herb Grain Salad
ingredients: A handful parsley and mint, chopped
method: Heat oven to 200°C fan.
Toss carrots and chickpeas with olive oil, cumin and smoked paprika.
Roast for 25–28 minutes until tender.
Cook bulgur wheat according to packet and fluff with a fork.
Whisk lemon zest, lemon juice and a little olive oil.
Combine bulgur, carrots, chickpeas, spring onions and herbs, then scatter with seeds.
why_this_works_for_tha: Wholegrain bulgur, chickpeas, carrots, herbs and seeds make a sturdy whole-food side or lunchbox main.
planner_readability_notes: can be served warm or cold

recipe_name: Pakistani-Style Feta, Parsnip & Cauliflower Egg Skillet
ingredients: 4 wholegrain wraps or slices of toast
method: Heat olive oil in a pan.
Cook parsnip and cauliflower until softened.
Add the protein and warm through or cook until done.
Season lightly with the listed spice.
Serve with wholegrain toast or wraps.
why_this_works_for_tha: Feta, parsnip, cauliflower and oats create a filling plant-forward meal built from recognisable ingredients and simple seasoning.
